tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// 'chi med bcud len gyi man ngag bkra shis zho yi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rnam 'dren bla mar dbyer med pa'i// rtsa gsum rgya mtshor gus btud nas// ring 'tsho'i thabs mchog bcud len bskor// gong ma'i gsung las btus te 'bri// de la'ang bzhi'i/ dang po sman gyi bcud len la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa 'di ltar yin te/ thog mar me tog rgyas pa'i dus su tshes brgyad lta bu'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe rang nyid grogs dang bcas pas khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i ngang nas ma ṇi zlo zhing me tog gi tshal du phyin la/ bad kan shas che na ba lu'i me tog mkhris pa la sbrang 'dzin zhes pa rtag tu ngu'i me tog rna ba mi bde na ug chos me tog ma nyams pa/ mig la dbyar mo thang ste rang rang gi nad gzhi dang bstun pa'am/ de bzhin min na dug gi rigs ma yin pa'i me tog thams cad kyang rung ste/ kun kyang mgul gyi shing bal sogs med par btus la lte ma gtsang mar grib bskams sam/ bya nan ma rul bar legs par bskams la/ phye zhib mor btags pa'i phye ma bre gang tsam la rab a ru ra gser mdog de ma rnyed na a ru ra sha chen thun gsum/ dbang lag thun phyed gsum/ dzā ti thun gcig rnams med kha med kyi sman dang*/ 'byor na bzang drug rnams dang a ka ru de dag las nad gzhir phan gang che a ru ra dang mnyam pa/ gzhan rnams thun phyed re ste thams cad kyang btags la bsres te/ sbrang bu ram gang 'thad kyis khu ba byas la ril bu lug gi ril ma che shos tsam byas te rin po che'am thod pa'i snod gtsang mar 'gom yug mi 'chor bar bzhag ste sbyor ba'i rim

1 pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ de nas gnas dben par byi dor byas/ rten gyi drung du mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ kha tsam min par yid 'khul nges kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang ste/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don dran pa'i ngang nas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs par gsal ba'i ngang nas spyan nam mkha' la gzigs pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad sprin gyi phung po bzhin du byon/ de dag gi byin rlabs dang*/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste 'byung ba lnga'i bcud thams cad dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ srid pa gsum gyi bkrag mdangs gzi brjid/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug nas ril bu rnams la rim par thim pas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa a mṛ ta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes bstod smra bcad byas nas bzla ste/ yi ge snga ma dag tu ha ri ni sa zhes pa mi 'byung yang ma dag pa yin no// ril bu bsgrub pa'i rim 2 pa'o// de nas bza' ba'i tshul ni/ dus gsum mam gnyis kyi tshe rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa'i dmigs pa sngar ltar byas la sngags nyer gcig bzlas te thug pa sla sing nge ba phor bu do res phul la ri lu re mid pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas stong nyid yul du byas pa'i bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsams la bza' zhing*/

yun ni zhag nyer gcig bya ste/ zhag bdun phrag dang po la lto dang*/ gnyis pa la nad byang zhing*/ gsum pa la lus zungs skye ba yin la/ de yang nad kyi phyir du byed pa yin la/ gzhan du ni nges pa med do// ril bu za tshul gyi rim 3 pa'o// de'i skabs su spyod lam ni lus kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang bskor ba/ ngag bzlas brjod/ yid lha'i sgom bzlas sogs kyis mi dal bar bya ste/ gzhan du bad kan skye bas nad kyi rgyur 'gyur ba la rlung gi geg 4 sa sel ba la 'bad pa gal che'o// ja dang bu ram gyi lde gu cung zad re ma gtogs zas rags pa spang ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi phan yon ni/ nad gzhi kun la phan/ tshe ring*/ lus mdangs legs/ rgas kha sra/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma nyung*/ nad yan pas mi tshugs/ lus la shig sro mi 'byung*/ shes rab che/ rig pa dwangs/ zas dang log 'tshos ma gos pas lam gyi rtogs pa skye sla/ mis byams/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba sogs nges par 'byung ste phan yon gyi rim 5 pa'o// ༈ /gnyis pa rde'u'i bcud len la/ rdo brtag pa dang gcig thu ba dang gnyis/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang gsum/ za thabs dang bzhi/ dam tshig dang lnga/ gegs sel dang drug yon tan dang bdun/ khungs bstan pa dang brgyad las/ dang po rdo brtag 1 pa ni/ rdo rigs lnga ste/ sha chen tshil chen gnyis/ rus pa can/ mkhris pa can gnyis/ shi sha can dang lnga las/ sha chen ni mdog gar yang rung la so mi brtse zhing sha chen nyams can/ tshil chen dkar la tshil bu'i rnam pa yod pa/ rus can ni/ dkar sgong dang me rdo lta bu/ mkhris pa can ni g.ya' ma dang ljang gu chu rdo'i rigs so// shi sha can ni rdo phal pa rnams so// bsten pa ni sha tshil can bsten cing*/ gzhan rnams spang bya'o// de nas rdo thu ba 2 ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig par bskyed/ sor mo rnams mkha' 'gro lngar bsgom/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du bskyed/

rdo bdud rtsir bsams la sngags 'di bzlas la thu'o// oṃ trig ye ra trig ye ra swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing mdun du bsag de nas rtsa gsum mchog gsum skyabs yul thams cad bstims la snod du blugs/ rdo thu ba'i thabs yin/ de nas byin rlabs byed pa 3 'i thog mar zangs dkar g.ya' can nam/ rdza gang rigs kyi snod du/ sman bzang drug la sogs pas bcos/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rde'u rnams ka pā la'i nang du blugs/ skyabs sems spyi mthun rjes/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ snang srid chos kun 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang*// rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// spyan gsum cung zad zhi khro'i nyams dang ldan// phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa// sha lnga bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin// rin chen rus rgyan gru mor kha ṭwāṃ 'chang*// rna ltag g.yas na phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs// thod skam dbu rgyan rlon pa'i do shal can// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pad nyi ro gdan bzhugs// me dpung 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhengs// de yi dbu gtsug rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams// 'ja' 'od klong na tho brtsegs tshul du bzhugs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod la/ rde'u rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar mos la/ byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ mu le mu le ma hā mu le swā hā/ zhes brgya stong bzlas la phu gdab/ bgegs bsal gyi sngags ni/ oṃ sha pa tri shi shag shig swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas te rde'u la 'debs/ bza' tha 4 bas ni/ dang po mar dkar mthe bong tsam re rde'u'i snga phyir btang*/ rjes su ma byung yang rung*/ ja chang skyo tsha gang rigs phor tshad re tsam gyis phul te mid rjes gsol 'debs ni/ na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī bhyaḥ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung mkha' 'gro ni gu mar// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'byung ba rdo yi bcud mchog lon pa dang*// bcud len mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum rnam mkhyen phyogs las rnam rgyal la// gsol ba=

/'byung ba= /bcud len= /ras chen chos rje sangs rgyas bzang mo la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /rin chen rgyal po 'jam dbyangs padma gar// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /grags pa 'od zer rab 'byams chos kyi rje// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /ratna'i mtshan can 'dus chen rab rgyas la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /'jam dbyangs dga' ba rin chen bzang po la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /'jigs med rnam rgyal 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /rig 'dzin rnam rgyal bde chen mtsho mo la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /tshul khrims rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /yi dam mkha' 'gro bkra shis 'od 'bar la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i spun grogs la// gsol ba= /'byung ba= /bcud len= /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu longs sku thugs rje chen po la thim/ longs sku thugs rje chen po sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la thim/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ni gu ma la thim/ ni gu ma 'jigs med grags pa= 'jigs med grags pa dpal 'byor bzang po la= ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po yang 'od du zhu ḍā ki ma sangs rgya bzang mo= sangs rgyas bzang mo yang= mkhas grub rin chen rgyal po la= mkhas grub chen po= 'jam dbyangs padma gar dbang la= 'jam dbyangs padma gar dbang yang= rje btsun grags pa 'od zer la= grags pa 'od zer yang= rab 'byams chos rje la= rab 'byams chos rje yang= ratna'i mtshan can la= ratna'i mtshan can yang= 'dus chen rab rgyas la= 'dus chen rab rgyas yang= 'jam dbyangs dga' ba la= 'jam dbyangs dga' ba yang= bka' drin 'khor med rin chen bzang po la= rin chen bzang po yang= sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'jigs med rnam rgyal la= sbas pa'i rnal 'byor yang= rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la=

'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal yang= rig 'dzin rnam rgyal la= rig 'dzin rnam rgyal yang 'od du zhu chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo la= chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo yang= thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rdo rje la thim/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rdo rje yang 'od du zhu/ bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer ma mchis pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu thob/ sems gzung 'dzin dang bral bar mnyam par bzhag go /'di'i dam tshig la/ rdo byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang*/ yi dam ma bsgoms par mi bza'/ gzhan la gsang zhing nyams grib la 'dzem/ zas gos gsog 'jog mi bya tshogs su gtang*/ thig le nyams su mi 'jug sngags 'dren skabs ngag mi gtong*/ gegs sel ni/ 'di nyams su len pa'i dus su tshe 'di blos mi thong ba dang*/ bza' snying mi 'dod pa dang*/ dka' thub dang dam bca' blos gtang bar 'dod pa byung na/ gegs dang bar chad du shes par byas la/ na shi ltogs rgyags ci byung rung*/ 'dis mgo thon pa mi bya re snyam pa'i blo shad bskyed/ des gegs mi 'ong*/ gal te byung na sel thabs chu bskol la mar btab nas 'thung*/ skyug na chu dron gtang*/ 'byams na skyo cha gtang*/ rlung la rlung sman bsten/ des gegs sel lo// 'di'i yon tan la rdo bza' ba'i dus su yog tshad zos pas mchog lto gos kyi rtsol ba chad/ zhag bdun brgyad nas kyis sha bri/ dri chung*/ zhag bcu nas shed dang*/ sha dwangs skyel/ shes pa dang dbang po gsal/ dge sbyor la bogs thon/ rdo la ro mchog thon/ lus yang zhing mgyogs/ srog chags mi 'byung*/ drod skye/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis rlob/ dpa' bo dang ḍā ki 'du/ chos skyong dang lha srin bran du 'gyur/

zas nor dang longs spyod 'du/ mngon shes dang 'od gsal gyi nyams skye/ dge sbyor la brtan pa thob/ ser sna dang chags pa'i dri ma dag phyi ma mu ge'i bskal pa las thar ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*// rdo'i 'byung khungs bstan pa ni/ spa gro stag tshang*/ chu bo ri'i nub dang byang*/ phag mo gru/ gzho stod ti gro brag dkar/ lho brag mkhar chu/ gzed kyi bye ma lung sogs la yod do// bdud rtsi rdo'i bcud len gyi gdams ngag gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa rdzogs so// ༈ /gsum pa me tog bcud len la/ dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i lugs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas 'jigs bral dus gsum rnam mkhyen la snyan brgyud du gdams pa'i dka' thub me tog bcud len gyi gdams pa la don gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes phan yon bstan pa'o// de la dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa la/ me tog thu ba ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dkar mo'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas snying po bzla bzhin du sa gtsang sa me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i sa'i char kha shar du bltas te dug rigs med pa'i rtsi shing gang yang rung ba'i me tog rnams phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis mgul pa nas bcad phyag g.yon pa'i thod pa'i nang du blugs par bsams la bsdus te/ de rnams rul sum med pa'i grib bskam du byas pa cha gnyis/ dug rigs med pa'i sman sna tshogs kyi cha gcig ste/ de yang so so'i nad babs dang bstun pa'i phan byed kyi me tog dang sman sogs mang ba gtong lugs bya/ de gnyis bre gang gi tshod tsam la zhib phul gang btab pa 'dam 'thag legs par byas te ril bu kham tshig tsam bsgril la ril chags dang grib skam bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi de nyid sgrub pa ni/ gnas khang byi dor dang spos chus chag chag gdab/ ril bu rnams ka pā la'i nang du blugs la nyer mchod bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid phag mo'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gu gul gyis bdug

yungs kar gyis brabs/ rang dang ril bu gnyis ka swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ snang srid chos kun 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang*// rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// spyan gsum cung zad zhi khro'i nyams dang ldan// phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa// bdud rtsi ril bus gang ba thugs kar 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pad nyi ro steng bzhugs// me dpung 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na gsal// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan par gsal gdab/ de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs/ ril bu phag mor gsal ba la thim par dmigs te/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ha ri nis a mṛ ta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong bzlas rjes ril bu lhar gsal ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos/ rang yi dam gyi bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ja chang gang rigs kyi phor tshad res phul te ril bu gnyis re khyur med du gtang*/ dka' thub kyi zas la bsten dgos pa yin tshe/ thugs pa sla seng ba bka' brgyud rin po ches gsung pa ltar phul re gtang*/ dmigs pa ni rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ste bde stong lhan skyes ye shes g.yo med kyi rang mdangs 'gags med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni spyi bor bla ma kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang yab yum bskyed la/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ gnas mchog 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mchog dpal mo chos sding chos grwa ru// kun mkhyen phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mchog sham po gangs kyi ra ba ru// mi nyag rin chen rgyal ba la gsol ba 'debs// gnas mchog gsang phu ne'u thang yang steng du// mtshungs med ras ston chos rje la= /gnas mchog ri khrod yangs pa'i dgon pa ru// bya btang kun mkhyen chos mdzad la=

/gnas mchog zab pa lung gi dgon pa ru// grub chen ba lu'i me tog la= /gnas mchog bkra shis dpal gyi dgon pa ru// 'dren mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus la= /gnas mchog bye tshags dben pa'i ri khrod du// rje btsun ratna'i mtshan can la= /gnas mchog 'on phu dkar gyi ri khrod du// rje btsun dpal ldan grags pa la= /gnas mchog shel dkar cog pu'i pho brang du// 'gro mgon lcog grwa yab sras la= /gnas mchog thub bstan chos 'khor chos grwa ru// skyabs mchog 'jam dbyangs dga' ba la= /gnas mchog lha rtse bla ma'i gdan sa ru// mnyam med rin chen bzang po la= /gnas mchog gar bzhugs dag pa'i pho brang du// skyabs mgon dge legs rgyal mtshan la= /gnas mchog dga' ldan lha rtse'i pho brang du// 'dren mchog 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal la= /gnas mchog byang chub sbyor lam pho brang du// bskal bzang rin chen rnam rgyal la= /gnas mchog mkha' spyod bsam grub chos sding du// chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo la= /gnas mchog sbyor rtse chos kyi pho brang du// kun mkhyen tshul khrims rdo rje la= /gnas mchog spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /gnas mchog rang lus rgyal ba'i pho brang du// rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la= /gnas mchog dag snang phyogs med gzhal yas su// mched grogs chos mdzad thams cad la= /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par= /bde drod lus la 'bar bar= /stong nyid snying rje 'byongs par= /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs par= /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje phag mo go 'phang myur thob shog /ces gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsams te/ dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug sogs dang*/ bsngo smon rnams phyag chen gsol 'debs kyi rjes ltar song rjes/

rang nyid phag ma'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rtsa bug stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis byang sems bdud rtsis gang bar dmigs te rlung bum can gang lcogs re 'dzin/ thun mtshams thams cad rlung phyag la brtson pa dang*/ lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor sogs la 'bad/ ltogs gegs bsal phyir nam mkha' zas su za ba'i dmigs pa ni 'og rlung cung zad bsdam/ hūm̐ zhes pas steng rlung drag tu rngubs pas nam mkha' sngo 'dur gyis zhu nas sna bug nas drangs khong du mid par bsam/ gsum pa rjes phan yon dang dam tshig sogs rde'u dang mtshungs/ nyin re thun bzhi'i rim pas zhag bdun bsten no// ril bu lhag byung tshe rjes su gtong chog pas snod ko khug sogs rlung mi shor ba'i nang la blugs te tshags bya'o// me tog bcud len gyi gdams pa rdzogs so// ༈ /bzhi pa chu'i bcud len la/ de la gang 'thung rgyu'i chu ni/ mtsho chu dang*/ ba tshwa can dang*/ nyi zla'i 'od ma phog pa'i khron chu sogs ma yin pa blangs nas/ zhag bdun sogs yun ring lon pa'i chu rus rnams dang bskol nas zhag 'das pa ma yin zhing*/ ring nas 'bab pa'i chu klung gtso bo dang*/ chu mig gi chu 'jam po la yang rung*/ chu mig gi chu mgo nas blangs pa dang*/ chu dreg yod pa la mi bya'o// chang chu sogs chu'i bzang ngan bshad tshul yang sman rgyud las/ chu ni char chu gangs chu chu klung chu// chu mig khron pa ba tshwa shing gi chu// rim pas dang po mchog yin phyi ma dman// zhes gsungs shing*/ gangs chu ni gangs can las 'bab pa'i chu yin la/ kha ba'i chu spang bya yin par bshad/ mkha' las 'bab pa'i char chu ni rang byung gi yan lag brgyad ldan yin te/ rgyud las/ mkha' las 'bab pa ro mi gsal la zhim// 'tsho ngoms bsil la yang bas bdud rtsir mtshungs// zhes dang*/ yan lag brgyad par/ mkha' las 'bab pa gaṅgā'i chu// 'tsho byed ngoms byed yi gar 'ong*// tshim zhing sems ni gsal byed pa// sla zhing ro mi gsal la zhim// bsil zhing yang bas bdud rtsir mtshungs// zhes gsungs te/

yan lag brgyad ldan ngos 'dzin tshul yang brgyad stong 'grel chen du/ dri zhim mngar dang bsil ba dang*// yang dang dwangs dang gtsang ba dang*// 'thung na lto dang mgrin pa la// mi gnod yan lag brgyad ldan chu// zhes drangs so// bcos pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan ni/ rang byung rdo rjes/ chu bskol yan lag brgyad dang ldan// rlung gnon bad kan 'byin par byed// ces dang*/ rgyud las/ chu bskol zas 'ju drod skyed skyigs bu sel// bad kan lto sbos dbugs mi bde ba dang*// chams pa rims gsar 'phral du ldog par byed// ces dang*/ paṇa chen zla ba mngon dgas/ yul dus lci dang yang ba las// bzhi cha sum cha phyed gdu bar// lbu ba med par bskol pa ni// shugs med dri ma med cing phan// zhes so// chus nyes pa skyed pa yang rgyud las/ zhag gcig lon nas dug 'dra nyes kun skyed// ces dang*/ rang byung rdo rjes/ chu ni zhag lon nyes gsum skyed// ma gdus khreb po de dang mtshungs// zhes pa ltar ro// gang gis 'thung ba'i gang zag ni/ tshe 'di blos btang nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su gzhol zhing sgrub pa mdzad 'dod pa la/ mthun pa'i rkyen ma 'dzoms pa'am de la ma ltos pa zhig go /nam 'thung ba'i dus ni/ ston ka ṛ ṣi 'char ba sogs chu bzang ba'i dus su thog mar brtsams te/ goms nas dus thams cad du chu 'ba' zhig gis 'tsho bar bya'o// ji ltar 'thung ba'i tshul ni/ zas skom la ma ltos par dam chos sgrub pa pos chu 'ba' zhig gis lus rten 'tsho ba'i thabs su chu'i bcud len la je chung je chung rim gyis goms shing sbyong ba ste/ de'ang rang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'am phag mo mngon rtogs bzhin bsgom/ chu legs par bskol zhing gdus par rtsam pa thur ma re btab pa bzung nas/ oṃ laṃ laṃ rung rung zhi zhi nyal nyal swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas thugs ka'i phaiṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i drang srong rnams kyi tshe'i dngos grub/ lha'i bdud rtsi'i bcud thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par bkug nas chu la thim par bsam/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te btung ngo*// oṃ dza le swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas pas gegs mi 'byung*/ oṃ thud de thud de/ thung ta thung ta swā hā/ nyer gcig bzlas pas srin log spong zhes gsungs/ dben sa pas/ sa ra ha'i 'bebs sbyong gsungs kyang yi ge snga ma rnams su ma byung ngo*// dmigs rim gtso che ba ni/ 'thung pas lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang*/ bdud rtsi spyi bor lud pa las padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su he ru ka sngon po bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum phag mo bum thod 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu padma/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu thams cad kyang bum thod 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs la thim par mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ bde mchog gsang gnas dang lha rnams kyi bum thod nas bdud rtsi babs pas lus thams cad bde bas gang zhing nad gdon bkres skom ma lus zhi bar bsam/ lus mi sdod de 'khrul 'khor/ ngag mi sdod de bzlas pa/ yid mi sdod de ting nge 'dzin la brtson par dben pas gsungs/ de nas lus gnad bcas la pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor bya zhing*/ btsan thabs su gtum mo'i thabs lam nyi zla 'bar 'dzag ni/ lte bar nyi ma spyi bor zla ba gnyis dbu ma dang 'brel bar 'bru gsum bsams la/ bum pa can gyi 'bar 'dzag hūm̐ la thim par bsam mo// de yang thog mar nyi ma re re bzhin thun gsum gsum/ zla ba re song nas thun gnyis re/ de nas zla ba re song nas thun gcig gis thub/

rus snying gi khu ba legs par gdus par mar rnying bu ram tsha ba gsum dang rtsam pa bsres pa'i ril bu byas la/ zla ba dang por nyi ma re re bzhin gsum re/ zla ba re song nas gnyis re/ zla re song nas ril bu res 'tsho bar nus pa ste/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dka' thub mdzad pa'i tshe shug 'bru rim bzhin bzhes pa'i rnam thar dang phyogs mthun pa yin no// rang byung rdo rjes bcud len du chu bskol bar rtsam pa btab par bshad pa ni thog ma nas zas thams cad gcod na bzod mi nus pas rim gyis sbyong dgos ched yin la/ rim gyis legs par sbyangs nas chu 'ba' zhig gis thub nges pa myong bas grub bo// dben sa pas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pas brtan pa thob// de'i ring la rtsam pa mi gtong*/ brtan pa thob na sha chang la sogs pa kha zas yod pa mi spang*/ med pa mi sgrub/ bcud len 'di lta bu la gnas par bya'o gsungs so// yang na/ lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag shar du bhrūm̐ ser po/ lhor am̐ dmar po/ nub tu bam̐ dkar po/ byang du kham̐ ljang gu gsal btab pa'am/ rang byung rdo rjes/ zas sred gcod nas rlung bzung*// mgrin par bhrūm̐ la shes pa gtad// skom sred gcod na chu rlung bzung*// spyi bor ba la shes pa gtad// gos sred gcod na me rlung bzung*// lte bar am̐ las shes pa gtad// rtog pa gcod na nam mkha'i rlung*// snying gar hūm̐ la bzung zhing bsgom// 'dod sred gcod na rlung gi rlung*// mthing ga gsang ba khaṃ la gtad// kun la ma bcos ting 'dzin bsgom// zhes pa gang rung lta bu zhig la dmigs pa gtad/ yi ge de las rang mdog can gyi bdud rtsi 'bab pas rtsa thams cad la khyab par bsams la rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ gegs sel ni/ rlung log pa byung na rus khu 'thung bas sel/ yun ring lon nas mngar gsum zos pas stobs 'phel bar 'gyur/ chu skyugs na bu ram 'debs/ chu 'gags pa la sga skya gtang*/

chu snyi ba la gzhug chung gtang*/ rlung langs na zwa tshod ma phor gang*/ dwang ga mi bde na sga/ chu bur byung na phye tshod phor gang gtang*/ mgo 'khor na rus snying gtang*/ phan yon ni/ rang byung bas/ zhag bdun lon nas nus pa rnyed// nyi shu rtsa gcig brtan pa zin// de nas gegs las thar pa yin// zla ba gcig gis legs par 'byongs// rjen pa'i zas dang grang mo'i chu// gtor mas 'byongs tshad nges pa'o// zla drug 'bad pas yon tan 'char// des na chags med ri khrod 'grims// zhag bdun nyams su blangs pa na// mu ge'i bskal pa dag las thar// nyer gcig kham gyi zas dang bral// lus yang dbug dal sems mi g.yo// zla gcig zas kyi rtsol sgrub bral// gnyid chung mdangs gsal rmi lam rno// zla drug ngo srung chos brgyad bral// zhes gsungs/ dben sa pas/ mi chags pa gsum ni/ lus la dri ma mi chags/ srin bu mi chags/ mi gtsang ba dang snabs lud mi chags/ 'du ba gsum ni/ nyin mo mi 'du/ nub mo mkha' 'gro 'du/ nang nub zas 'du/ bden pa gsum ni/ sems la sdug bsngal med pas bden/ yid la zhen chags med pas bden/ ngag ngan pa'i rdzun med pas bden/ bral ba gsum ni/ sems sdug bsngal dang bral/ lus ngal dub dang bral/ ngag rdzun dang bral/ bde ba gsum ni/ phyi snang ba la zhen pa med de bde/ nang nyon mongs pa la gnyen po mi dgos te bde/ gsang ba 'byung ba cha snyoms pas bde/ mnyam pa gsum ni/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam/ stobs glang po che dang mnyam/ mgyogs pa rlung dang mnyam/ grol ba gsum ni/ phyi nad las grol/ nang phung po las grol/ bar btang snyoms las grol/ zhes gsungs so// zhes pa'ang sgrub thabs rin po che kun las btus pa'i kha skong du gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod kyi khrod nas blo gter dbang pos nyung ngur bsdus pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad ring 'tsho'i rten la dam chos spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
